reason: Our terms already put agent risk on the customer, and our MCP server already has its own caps, so I can't justify a new line item that competes with a hire. If I wanted extra controls I'd look at an open-source policy layer before paying a startup.
objection: You want me to put an unaudited proxy from a company with zero customers in the path of every customer trade and payment. If it goes down or gets breached, that's my outage and my regulator conversation, and 'SOC 2 planned' doesn't get past my vendor review.
would_change_my_mind: FINRA or an examiner telling us in writing that our terms aren't enough and we need per-agent authorization controls and decision records, with the gate open source or SOC 2 Type II done by then.
